high_level_description: The image is a vibrant and surreal depiction of three individuals standing against a cosmic backdrop, which suggests a space or nebula theme. The central figure is dressed in a formal suit with a red tie, holding a glowing, transparent cube that emits a bright light. Flanking the central figure are two other individuals, also in formal attire, each holding similar glowing cubes. Their heads are encased in transparent helmets, through which their faces are faintly visible, adding an element of mystery and otherworldliness.
